name: Mysteries of the House: The Maiden & the Moon
source:
The Maiden presents an old, mysterious book gifted to her by a House visitor. Unbeknownst to everyone, the book is cursed. Before they know it, they're transported to a world called "Wonderland". Will they find their way back home, or will they succumb to the darkness stirring within this magical world?

[From [url=https://spark180.itch.io/the-maiden-and-the-moon]itch.io[/url]]
